retainedMemoryFollowup.scope: Independent matched repetition. Forced GC via CDP after completion; JS heap is whole-page retained heap, not attributable exclusively to native clips. Documents/nodes differ; this is not a leak-free claim. Backing byte categories are separate and not additive.

interpretation: Observed cost, not an optimization claim: one controlled workload and no statistical performance claim. The larger native clips and preallocated effects add memory. Coarse performance.memory samples include uncollected allocations; use the explicit post-GC follow-up for retained-heap observations.
